caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular, metal teapot with a dark brown color and subtle highlights indicating metallic reflections. The teapot has a flat, rectangular lid with a handle in the center, a protruding spout on the right side, and a large, curved handle on the left, all drawn in the same brownish-metal tone with shading to suggest volume. The object is placed against a plain, light beige background with no other objects or patterns present, making the teapot the sole subject of the composition. There is a faint signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Teapot
